capabilities.description: Copy a record, its children, everything they reference and the schemas it lacks into a mounted board, as one commit there, and move the mount's pin to it.

inputSchema.description: Copy the entry at `path`, its children and every entry its records reference into the board mounted at `to`.

dry_run.description: List what would be copied and the plugin's own refusals, and write nothing, when true. Board's checks for a write through a mount run only on the real call.
dry_run.title: Dry Run

local_attachments.description: Copy an attachment whose bytes are on this machine, which other readers cannot fetch, when true.
local_attachments.title: Local Attachments

path.description: The record or file to share, such as /evals/x; its children under /evals/x/ go with it.
path.title: Path

to.description: The mount record of the board to copy into, such as /team; the share writes through it.
to.title: To

inputSchema.title: ToInput

capabilities.name: to

outputSchema.description:
What the share copied, or would copy on a dry run.

`repository` is the repository the mount reaches. `commit` is the commit
in it that holds the copies, which the mount's pin now names, null when
nothing was written. `types` are the types whose schemas were added in
that commit. `copied` lists at most 100
paths; `total` counts them all, and `truncated` says whether some were left
out. `unchanged` counts the paths the destination already held equally.
outputSchema.title: ToOutput

description: Copy a record from this board into a mounted board, such as a team's, with its children, every record and file it references and the schemas of their types, so a reader there can open it. Use it when someone else needs to read a record you wrote. Start with `board -C <board> call share.to --path /<record> --to /<mount> --dry_run true`, which lists what would be copied. SKILL.md and README.md in the plugin's directory say more.
name: share
